propositions: Recovery preflight refuses context 121,147 chars with 22 criteria despite total product (2.67M) staying under previously ratified worst case (3.2M), because per-axis flat bound _MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS=100k was arbitrary and outgrown a second time

Two distinct ceilings conflate in the flat constant: physical (single model window) and economic (per-criterion fan-out multiplier); each must be expressed independently and derived from configuration

Physical ceiling must derive from the resolved verifier model's own context window tokens (not escalation max) times conservative 2 chars/token ratio; moving MODEL_LADDER to shared model_classes.py enables this without plan-review semantics leaking into completion
Economic ceiling (sum of all recovery re-sends) should be explicit as _MAX_RECOVERY_INPUT_CHARS=3_200_000 and checked as context_chars × criteria_count product, replacing the per-axis split

c9f7's 121,147-char context must pass _validate_recovery_inputs preflight with default claude-sonnet-4-6 model (derived ceiling 2M chars, product 2.67M < 3.2M bound); haiku-rung model must enforce 400k-char physical ceiling independently

All refusals remain visible with diagnostic fields {context_chars, context_char_limit, criteria_total, recovery_input_chars, recovery_input_char_limit}; nothing is elided; d59e's pinned invariants (no elision, criteria budget ≤ context budget, zero billable calls on refusal) are preserved
